selected_beats.action_beat: A low-angle view of a dark passage opening up to reveal the bright interior of the special cage. Winnie, a large brown furry polar bear, steps out into the light, causing Christopher Robin to rush toward him with an expression of joyful discovery.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Wide shot, capturing the contrast between the deep shadows of the passages and the illuminated enclosure entrance.

selected_beats.action_beat: Piglet peeks out nervously from a small opening near the rim of the ink-pot, gazing down into its glossy, opaque, and highly reflective murky depths. The lighting is concentrated and low, highlighting his anxious expression against the dark surface.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Close up, framed tightly on Piglet's viewpoint looking down into the vessel, emphasizing depth and contained mystery.
